formulas.absolute_score: sum over criteria of (score / max_score) * weight
formulas.benchmark: highest validated score for the criterion across all suppliers in the run
formulas.gap: score - benchmark (0 for the benchmark leader, otherwise negative)
formulas.relative_pct: score / benchmark * 100; if benchmark == 0 then 0 (no supplier showed evidence, no peer credit)

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: The solution offers Azure hosting, certified SAP S/4HANA connectivity, and has been tested to scale to 10 million spend lines. However, integration with Coupa relies on nightly CSV file exports rather than an automated direct API.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Hosted analytics platform on Azure with a certified SAP S/4HANA connector and nightly CSV import for Coupa. Tested with 10 million spend lines. Standard spend, supplier and contract dashboards.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: A structured 16-week waterfall schedule is defined with designated milestones, governance meetings, and a 5 FTE delivery team. However, task-level work breakdown and contingency planning are minimal.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Delivery follows a waterfall plan with a weekly status report and a monthly steering meeting....Team: Project manager, solution architect, 2 data engineers, BI developer (5 FTE)....Monthly risk review; top risks tracked in a shared register.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: The fixed pricing structure covers licensing, implementation, connector, and support over three years. However, Azure consumption is billed at cost separately, adding an estimated $3,000 per month in variable expenditure.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Assumptions:...• Azure consumption billed at cost, estimated at $3,000/month....• Coupa data provided as nightly CSV exports by Northwind.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: Strong security posture backed by ISO/IEC 27001 certification, SAML 2.0 SSO, encryption in transit and at rest, and GDPR readiness. The audit log retention period is limited to one year.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] ISO/IEC 27001 certified. Encryption at rest and in transit. SSO via SAML 2.0....Role-based access; audit log retained for 1 year. GDPR DPA available.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: Relevant experience is shown across four retail implementations since 2021. However, support is limited to business hours with a 4-hour critical response window, and actual references are withheld until shortlisting.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] Support: Business-hours support with 4-hour response for critical incidents; quarterly service reviews....Relevant experience: Four procurement analytics projects for mid-sized retailers since 2021....Two retail references available after shortlisting.

suppliers.tie_break_note: Ranked above Echo Analytics: PPI tie, earlier submission date (2026-02-20 vs 2026-02-24).
risks: Azure consumption is excluded from the fixed fee and billed at cost, exposing the client to ongoing cost volatility.
Coupa integration is dependent on client-managed nightly CSV exports rather than a resilient API integration.
Support is limited to business hours with a four-hour response window for critical incidents, which may impact operational continuity.
Client references are conditional upon shortlisting and were not provided upfront for verification.
suppliers.overall_summary: Delta Analytics presents a solid mid-tier proposal featuring an established SAP connector, ISO 27001 certification, and relevant retail domain experience. Key concerns include pass-through cloud consumption costs, dependence on CSV file transfers for Coupa data, business-hours-only support, and deferred client references.
